addedTheme.description: A theme someone made, as the account added it.

addedAt.description: When the account added it, which orders its themes, the latest first, beside those it made.

name.description: What the theme was called when it was added.

uri.description: The dev.knotless.theme it was copied from.

appearancePref.description: How the pages are drawn for the account: in one theme, or with night, in this one by day and night's at night, as the system's light or dark says.

night.description: The theme the pages are drawn in at night, while the system is dark; this preference's own theme by day. Absent, the pages are drawn in one theme.

palette.description: The colours of a theme of the account's own, which theme custom draws the pages in: a copy of a dev.knotless.theme's, or made only for itself.

source.description: The dev.knotless.theme palette was copied from, if it was.

theme.description: The colours the pages are drawn in, as their Appearance settings name them: custom for those of palette. Absent, or one the pages do not know, they follow the system's light or dark.

main.description: The asking account's preferences, as the appview keeps them, apart from any record: one of each kind, of those it has set, and always its notifications, which dev.knotless.listNotifications and getUnreadCount follow. A kind it has not set a reader takes as its default. The pages' login copies what they act on into the browser. Requires authentication: a service token, or the session cookie the pages' login sets.

errors.description: This appview keeps no index, so it keeps no preferences.
errors.name: NotFound

notificationPref.description: Which notifications the account hears of. Until it says, every reason, from anyone.

followedOnly.description: Whether it hears only of what accounts it follows on knotless did. Not, when absent.

reasons.description: Reasons a notification is given for, each on or off. Given back, every one dev.knotless.listNotifications gives; set, one not named is on.

notificationReason.description: Whether an account hears of one reason's notifications.

preferences.description: An account's preferences, each of a kind.
At most one of each kind. Kinds unknown to a reader are passed over.

themeChoice.description: A theme the pages are drawn in, as appearancePref names its own.

palette.description: The colours theme custom draws the pages in.

source.description: The dev.knotless.theme palette was copied from, if it was.

theme.description: The colours the pages are drawn in, as their Appearance settings name them: custom for those of palette. Absent, or one the pages do not know, they follow the system's light or dark.

themesPref.description: The themes people made that the account added to its own, to choose from on Appearance: each a copy, so a theme changed or deleted later leaves the account's as it was. Set whole, as each kind is.

themes.description: The themes added, the latest first.

description: The asking account's preferences, of how knotless is shown to it.
